Get A Reservation Now View Menu Hello dear Welcome To Islanders Restaurant & Bar Welcome to Islanders Restaurant & Bar, a hidden gem on Dauphin Island, AL, where the flavors of New American cuisine meet the fresh zest of Southern and seafood delights. Our story is one of passion for fresh ingredients and vibrant dishes, thoughtfully crafted for every palate—including vegetarian options. From our cozy outdoor seating to the lively atmosphere, we invite families and friends to gather for lunch or dinner. With convenient services like delivery and catering, along with a full bar, we strive to create memorable dining experiences. Join us and savor the taste of island life, one dish at a time. see more Discover moreBeaches & IslandsFish & SeafoodRestaurants About Islanders Restaurant & Bar Welcome to Islanders Restaurant & Bar, a hidden gem located on the picturesque Dauphin Island, Alabama. This delightful establishment combines the essence of New American cuisine with Southern charm, delivering a fresh take on seafood and southern-style dishes that will leave your taste buds dancing. What sets Islanders apart is its commitment to community and its focus on quality, offering a diverse menu that caters to everyone. The restaurant takes pride in its extensive selection of vegetarian options, ensuring that both meat-lovers and plant-based diners can find something to savor. The ambiance is casual and inviting, making it the perfect spot for lunch or dinner, whether you're dining solo or with a group. Location: 1504 Bienville Blvd, Dauphin Island, AL 36528 Contact: (251) 861-2225 Utilities: Reservations accepted Delivery and Takeout options available Outdoor seating for those sunny days Full bar offering a variety of drinks Good for kids, catering, and groups Free Wi-Fi for diners From my experience, the seafood dishes are thoughtfully prepared and highlight the freshness of local ingredients. Each bite transports you to the warm beaches of the Gulf Coast. The fried seafood platter is a must-try, featuring perfectly golden fish and shrimp that are as much a visual delight as they are delicious. The flavors are complemented by a refreshing array of house-made sauces that elevate every dish. Moreover, Islanders Restaurant & Bar is equipped with modern amenities including accepting credit cards, Apple Pay, Android Pay, and even cryptocurrency, making your dining experience both convenient and enjoyable. The establishment is family-friendly, featuring a dedicated children's menu and a casual atmosphere perfect for an evening gathering. With a menu that changes seasonally and a commitment to sustainability, Islanders Restaurant & Bar not only serves up fantastic food but also prioritizes a meaningful dining experience for its patrons. If you find yourself in the area, this is a destination you won’t want to miss. So, gather your friends or family, or simply treat yourself — a visit to Islanders promises a memorable adventure for your palate.Discover moreMeat & SeafoodRestaurant Delivery ServicesBars, Clubs & Nightlife Come experience the magic at Islanders Restaurant & Bar, where the flavors of the island meet exceptional service in an ambiance you’ll love. Book a table Make A Reservation You can Book a table online easily in just a couple of minutes. Just check the availability of your table & book it now! Please contact the phone number +1 251-861-2225 “ On a mini vacation, went specifically for the bread pudding. Oh my, had the fish of the day basket which was Mahi Mahi, blackened, baked potato and took the bread pudding to go. Got back to the hotel and opened the desert, it was absolutely delicious! Very friendly staff, reasonable prices. Would highly recommend. They also had a staffed bar for those of you that indulge! Enjoy! ” - Valerie Lee “ This was the first restaurant we chose to eat at on this vacation at Dauphin Island. There were only two other tables that were set when we arrived My husband wanted a Michelob ultra and after asking twice I finally went to the bar and got him one. The view is excellent. There is no bad place to sit in the restaurant. The view is excellent. There is no bad place to sit in the restaurant. It is upstairs but it offers an accessible elevator which was good for my husband who has low vision. ” - Stacey Morgan “ We found our place to eat on vacation this year! The food was delicious, the service was excellent, and the atmosphere was inviting. Thank you for the experience! I highly recommend if you are looking for great food. The scallops and calamari were on point! I cannot express how much I needed this in my Alabama visit. ” - Trish Johnson “ We reserved a table for 6 at this restaurant on a Thursday night. The place was packed but we were seated. It's got a very chill feel to it, there was live music and really pretty over head lights. There's also outdoor dining as well. It took 45 minutes to get our drinks (6 waters and a tea) and another 45 minutes for food. Our orders came out at different times so one of our friends didn't receive their meal until around 2 hours after our arrival. They were extremely understaffed, but acknowledged that we were waiting a long time - our waitress was stressed and the kitchen was behind. However, we got a free bread pudding and a free meal as compensation for our wait. BUT, the food was amazing. Hands down the best dinner I've had on the island this vacation. Most of the table had side salads which were of decent size and quality. I ordered a bowl of gumbo and the sweet Thai shrimp. Both were delicious. They had their own Asian slaw and their gumbo wasn't spicy. The other dish pictured is the Islanders seafood plate - we chose to get blackened Cobia fish - it wasn't dry and was the right texture. I highly recommend going when it's not busy! ” - Karleeann Scovell “ First time on the island and decided to stop in and check it out! We were very pleased with our food and service! Thank you to Lisa at the bar for making our first time experience one to remember! Trust me I read all reviews and not sure why all are not 5 star reviews! Po’boy with fried shrimp, Thai chili breaded shrimp, Onion rings and hush puppies all excellent! Thank you for having Stella NA beer for my boyfriend and my Stoli vodka ginger ale for me! We will be back! ” - Camie Fillion “ We ate here while on a long weekend vacation. Our waitress was super nice and helpful. The good was really good and tasted Great. The drinks where also good. It is just a nice place to eat. I have only ate here once but that one time was good. It was for sure my favorite meal on Dauphin Island. ” - Matthew Humphrey “ I had the blackened fish tacos. Flavor was fantastic, atmosphere was comfortable and welcoming ” - Gloria Gardner Williams “ Ate outdoors since we have a baby that gets a little crazy occasionally; glad we did! relaxing island feel, delicious food, perfectly fried and flavorful. By far the best place to eat on Dauphin Island that we have been to. Top shelf margaritas are pretty good too! We will be regulars whenever we are in town for sure. ” - B Wiggs prevnext Address 1504 Bienville Blvd, Dauphin Island, AL 36528, United States View On Map Contact Phone: +1 251-861-2225 Send A Message Stay connected Try These Brands Too Plank's On Broadway 4022 Broadway, Grove City, OH 43123, United States Xi'an Impression London 117 Benwell Rd, London N7 7BW, United Kingdom DeMore's Offshore Bar & Grill - Sandusky, OH 302 W Perkins Ave, Sandusky, OH 44870, United States Katsudon-ya Zuicho Japan, 150-0042 Tokyo, Shibuya, Udagawacho, 4126 パピエビル Ron's Barn Barbecue & Seafood 3122 S Horner Blvd, Sanford, NC 27332, United States © 2025, All Rights Reserved
